title: Strings Exercises
explanation: Pon a prueba tus conocimientos sobre Strings resolviendo estos ejercicios.

exercises.question: Use the len method to print the length of the string.
Get the first character of the string txt.
Get the characters from index 2 to index 4 (llo).
Return the string without any whitespace at the beginning or the end.
Convert the value of txt to upper case.
Convert the value of txt to lower case.
Replace the character H with a J.
Insert the correct syntax to add a placeholder for the age parameter.
exercises.expected_output:
age = 36
txt = f'My name is John, and I am {age}'
print(txt)
